name: Plan
description: Structured planning process for complex tasks. Produces a detailed implementation plan as a markdown document, uploads it to Drive, and shares with the requester for approval. This process is READ-ONLY — it gathers information, analyzes options, and writes a plan. It NEVER executes, deploys, builds, or modifies any systems.

requester_email.description: Email of the user who requested the plan (auto-filled from intake)

steps.title: Research: gather requirements and current state
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT create, modify, deploy, or build anything.

Gather all relevant context for planning ${goal}:
1. Recall memory for any prior work or decisions related to this goal
2. Check project context (project-manage read) for existing infrastructure, services, and configuration
3. Read any relevant source files, configs, or documentation (use cat, ls, find — never write)
4. Identify constraints, dependencies, existing systems that must be preserved, and integration points
5. List the specific requirements and success criteria for ${goal}

Output a structured summary of: requirements, current state, constraints, and dependencies.
steps.accept_criteria: Requirements are clearly documented. Current system state is understood. Constraints and dependencies are identified. No files were created or modified.

steps.title: Analysis: evaluate approaches and select design
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT create, modify, deploy, or build anything.

For ${goal}, analyze at least 2 possible approaches:
1. For each approach: describe the architecture, list pros/cons, estimate complexity and risk
2. Consider what existing systems and configurations must be preserved (do NOT plan to overwrite production configs without explicit migration steps)
3. Select the best approach and document the rationale
4. Identify what needs to change, what must stay the same, and any migration/rollback concerns

Output a structured comparison of approaches with a clear recommendation.
steps.accept_criteria: At least 2 approaches considered with pros/cons. Best approach selected with clear rationale. Risks and preservation requirements identified. No files were created or modified.

steps.title: Write plan document and upload to Drive
steps.description:
⚠️ WRITE PLAN DOCUMENT ONLY — do NOT execute any part of the plan.

Create a markdown file with the implementation plan for ${goal}. The document must follow this structure:

```
# Implementation Plan: [concise title]

## Goal
What we're building and why.

## Architecture
How it fits into the existing system. Include systems that must be preserved.

## Execution Steps
Numbered steps in dependency order. For each step:
- What to do (specific commands, file changes, or configurations)
- What to verify after
- What to roll back if it fails

## Systems to Preserve
Existing configs, services, and infrastructure that must NOT be disrupted.

## Testing Plan
How to verify the implementation works end-to-end.

## Risks and Mitigations
What could go wrong and how to handle it.

## Requester
${requester_email}
```

Then do the following (in this exact order):
1. Write the plan to a local file: `shared/<mission_id>/plan.md`
2. Upload to Drive: `drive-upload --file shared/<mission_id>/plan.md --name "Plan — [short title].md"`
3. If requester_email is known (${requester_email}), share with them: `drive-share --file <FILE_ID_from_upload> --to user:${requester_email} --role commenter`
4. NEVER share with `anyone` — plans must remain private to the requester and agent.
5. Store the Drive link in project context: `project-manage update '${project_id}' '{"context":{"pending_plan":{"drive_link":"<webViewLink>","title":"<title>","status":"awaiting_approval"}}}'`

IMPORTANT: Do NOT start executing the plan. Only write and upload the document.
steps.accept_criteria: Plan markdown file written, uploaded to Drive, shared with requester (never public), and Drive link stored in project context. No implementation work was performed.

steps.title: Present plan for approval
steps.description: The implementation plan for ${goal} has been uploaded to Drive and shared with the requester. Review is needed before any execution can proceed.
steps.approval_message:
📋 Your implementation plan for **${goal}** is ready for review.

I've uploaded the full plan to your Drive — check your notifications for the shared document.

Please review and reply `approve` to proceed with execution, or `reject` to revise.
steps.accept_criteria: User has reviewed and approved or rejected the plan.
